subject: Engineered capacity slate: runtime queue priority request
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Recruitly <hiring@recruitly.io>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Engineered capacity slate: runtime queue priority request

Hi team,

This is a request to add 3 headcount FTEs to the runtime/serving roadmap for Q3: 2 Senior SWE (Levels 4-5) focused on priority queue throughput and one Staff SWE (Level 6) to lead the KV caching/compaction effort. We are seeing sustained traffic bursts from a set of enterprise customers and the current autoscaling buffer is insufficient without adding capacity or reworking the queue tiering. Quick summary: 

- Ask: 2x Senior SWE (start asap, remote-friendly) + 1x Staff SWE (start +8–12 weeks)
- Justification: expected 18% tail latency reduction and 30% lower 99th-percentile token cost across heavy QPS workloads if we implement queue sharding + hot-kv compaction.
- Budget: preliminary blended OTE run-rate ~ $1.05M/year (senior bands at mid-market + staff at band ceiling). Detailed band numbers attached.
- Rollout plan: hire seniors first to unblock immediate throughput work; staff SWE to ship architecture and runbook.

Attachments: runtime_capacity_rationale.pdf; comp_bands_q3.xlsx; org_impact_table.csv

I included Recruitly to confirm time-to-offer cadence if we get a greenlight. Requesting comments on comp bands, phasing, and any objections by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Director, Runtime Product
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Engineered capacity slate: runtime queue priority request

Thanks, Jasmine — clear ask. A few quick items I need before I can sign off on the budget: 

1) Can you break the $1.05M run-rate into comp / benefits / hiring fees / ramp? Put numbers per role.
2) What phasing do you propose for Q3 vs Q4 hiring? Is there an MVP we can ship with 1 senior + infra changes to delay the staff hire?
3) Any constraints on location / visa / remote that affect comp?

If we can show a 12-week runway improvement in throughput with 1 senior plus config tuning, I can advocate for fast approval for the first hire and stage the remainder. Please attach the headcount phasing table.

—Dev
VP, Platform Engineering
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Engineered capacity slate: runtime queue priority request

Adding a technical perspective: the two senior SWE reqs should be one focused on the continuous-batching/runtime kernel surface and one on the routing/cache layer. If we split seniority (1 L4, 1 L5) we can reduce blended comp while keeping velocity. The Staff SWE is important as a subtlety: we need someone to own KV compaction and the fallback policies across regions. That role could be a senior + strong IC in the near-term if we accept a longer runway for the compaction roadmap.

I built a quick phasing option in the attached org_impact_table.csv (see column: phased_option_b). Proposal: hire 1 Senior (L5) by end of July, hire 2nd Senior (L4) in September, Staff in November if earlier mitigations don't reach the SLA targets.

—Marcus
Head of Serving Runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Engineered capacity slate: runtime queue priority request

Appreciate the write-up. A couple of product/CS inputs: 
- We can postpone one of the senior hires if we narrow scope to top 3 enterprise customers (short-term mitigation), but that adds support load to CS.
- If finance is sensitive, consider hiring 1 Senior now and convert the 2nd into a contractor bench while recruiting for Staff — recruiting timeline for Staff tends to be longer.

Also looping in Laura explicitly for budget approval. Recruitly, can you share estimated time-to-offer for Senior L5 vs Staff L6?

—Marissa
VP, Customer Success (product partnership)

On Tue, Jun 22, 2027 at 09:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com> wrote:
> (See original request and attachments)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Engineered capacity slate: runtime queue priority request

Thanks for the detail and the options. Finance reviewed the comp_bands_q3.xlsx and the org_impact_table.csv. We can provisionally approve the following with conditions: 

- Immediate approval: hire 1x Senior SWE (L5) to start as soon as we have a signed offer. Budget: approve up to the mid-point of band.
- Conditional approval: 2nd Senior (L4) — approve contingent on demonstrating 8-week throughput gains from the first hire and no >2% impact to unit economics.
- Staff SWE (L6) — defer to Q4 hiring plan; we will revisit in early Oct after the phased outcomes.

Conditions: offers must be routed through Recruiting (Recruitly) and packaged within the bands in the spreadsheet. Any sign-on or relocation above the band ceilings needs Exec approval. Please work with Dev for the phasing KPIs and report results by Sep 15.

Once Recruiting confirms time-to-offer we can kick.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Finance & Ops
From: Recruitly <hiring@recruitly.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Engineered capacity slate: runtime queue priority request — Recruitly time-to-offer

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

Thanks for looping us in. Time-to-offer estimates based on your spec: 
- Senior SWE (L5): 21–28 days to offer (2–3 technical loops + 1 hiring committee).
- Senior SWE (L4): 28–35 days to offer (broader candidate pool + potential relocation discussions).
- Staff SWE (L6): 45–70 days to offer (narrow profile, passive search).

We can prioritize L5 candidates and start outreach today upon approval. Recruiter owner: Caleb Wong (caleb.wong@talenthub.com) will coordinate interview slates and recruiter sprints.

Attachments: (candidate slate template will be shared after kickoff)

—Recruitly Team
